* Create an Open environment by Balancing People and Client Experiences by Cultivating Trust.
* Lead Optimistically by Championing Growth and Development to Mobilize the Enterprise.

****Role Summary And Impact****
As part of the
**Global Operations Centre (GOC)**
, you will work closely with teams across the United States, Europe, and Asia to deliver high-impact solutions in a collaborative, multicultural environment. We are looking for a Manager - Display who will:
  
  

* Interact effectively with regional teams (Europe, U.S., Asia) and be a strong communicator.
* Lead Google Ads Display, Demand Gen and YouTube campaign launches and setup according to established processes.
* Ensure campaigns meet WPP-GOC, platform-policy and brand-safety requirements.
* Oversee pacing and optimize audiences, creatives, bids and placements.
* Ensure data accuracy for campaign reporting tools and WPP-GOC campaign management software.
* Produce daily and weekly pacing reports with insights and recommendations for regional Display teams.
* Line manages 2 – 5 directreportees (may vary based on the requirement)
* Lead the hands on execution & QA of junior team members as team grows.

****Skills And Experience****

* 4-6 years’ experience of planning and managing Google Ads Display, Demand Gen and YouTube campaigns.
* Proficient in English.
* Hands-on experience with Google Ads campaign setup, audience strategies and bidding across Display, Demand Gen and YouTube, including Maximize Conversions, Target CPA, Target ROAS, CPM and CPV.
* Strong understanding of responsive display ads, YouTube and Demand Gen creative formats, creative testing, placement quality and brand safety.
* Proficient in Microsoft Excel and Google Sheets
* You possess strong analytical skills and a natural affinity for numbers.
* You can analyse campaign data across CTR, CPC, CPM, CPV, CPA, conversions, view rate, reach and frequency, and develop actionable recommendations as needed.

****Life At WPP Media & Benefits****
Our passion for shaping the next era of media includes investing in our employees to help them do their best work, and we’re just as committed to employee growth as we are to responsible media investment. WPP Media employees can tap into the global WPP Media & WPP networks to pursue their passions, grow their networks, and learn at the cutting edge of marketing and advertising. Our benefits include competitive medical, group retirement plans, vision, and dental insurance, significant paid time off, preferential partner discounts, and employee mental health awareness days.
  
  
WPP Media is an equal opportunity employer and considers applicants for all positions without discrimination or regard to characteristics. We are committed to fostering a culture of respect in which everyone feels they belong and has the same opportunities to progress in their careers.

That's why we’ve adopted a hybrid approach, with teams in the office around four days a week. If you require accommodations or flexibility, please discuss this with the hiring team during the interview process.

Maifelz Technologies is a technology company that helps businesses simplify and optimize operations through intelligent ERP, AI, automation, and digital solutions. The organization specializes in Odoo ERP implementation, customization, integration, and support to streamline sales, CRM, accounting, inventory, purchasing, manufacturing, POS, and other core processes. The Enterprise Resources Planning Consultant will work closely with clients to assess business processes, gather requirements, and design ERP solutions that align with operational and strategic goals. This full-time role involves configuring and implementing ERP modules (with a focus on Odoo), conducting system testing, managing data migration, and ensuring smooth integration with existing tools and third‑party systems. The consultant will provide ongoing functional support, troubleshoot issues, document solutions, and deliver user training to promote effective adoption of ERP and automation initiatives. Daily responsibilities include analyzing workflows, recommending process improvements, preparing detailed functional specifications, and collaborating with technical teams on customizations and enhancements. This is a hybrid role based in Thrissur, with a mix of on-site client collaboration and work-from-home flexibility.

**Qualifications**

* Strong understanding of Business Process analysis and design, with the ability to map and optimize workflows across departments.
* Robust Analytical Skills to interpret data, evaluate process performance, and translate business requirements into practical ERP solutions.
* Hands-on experience with ERP Implementations and Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP) systems, preferably Odoo or similar platforms.
* Knowledge of Finance processes (e.g., general ledger, accounts payable/receivable, invoicing) and their integration within ERP environments.
* Experience working directly with clients or stakeholders, including requirements gathering, documentation, and solution presentation.
* Ability to collaborate with technical teams on system configuration, customization, and integrations, including testing and quality assurance.
* Strong communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to explain complex concepts in clear, user-friendly language.

description:
**Company Description**
Strands Post Tension Experts specializes in post-tensioning solutions for reinforced concrete structures, applying advanced prestressing methods to enhance strength and durability. The company focuses on introducing internal forces into concrete and masonry elements during construction to effectively counteract the service loads experienced in use. Using high-strength steel tensioning techniques, Strands Post Tension Experts delivers reliable structural performance through both pre-tensioning and post-tensioning methods. The team is committed to engineering precision, safety, and quality in every project, offering applicants the opportunity to work on technically challenging and impactful construction projects.

**Role Description**
The Project Manager role at Strands Post Tension Experts is a full-time, on-site position based in Kochi. The Project Manager oversees post-tensioning projects from planning through completion, ensuring timelines, budgets, and quality standards are met. Day-to-day responsibilities include coordinating with expeditors, logistics teams, site engineers, and inspection personnel, managing project schedules, and tracking material and equipment deliveries. The role involves preparing and maintaining project documentation, monitoring work progress on-site, resolving operational issues, and ensuring compliance with safety and technical specifications. description:
**About Axiado Corporation**
Axiado is redefining how AI infrastructure gets secured and managed. Founded in 2019, we’re a fast-growing, well-funded team of over 180 people worldwide, building the Trusted Control/Compute Unit (TCU), a new class of semiconductor that integrates hardware security, real-time platform management, and AI-driven optimization. Our TCU-based Platform Efficiency Controller is shipping hardware that makes AI servers measurably more efficient, more secure, and more reliable, and we’re extending that foundation into a hardware-anchored management fabric that scales from a single board to the whole fleet.
  
  
Backed by strong funding and validated by commercial programs with Tier 1 industry leaders, Axiado has earned recognition through numerous industry awards, including the 2026 AI in Cybersecurity Innovation Award from TMCnet, a Diamond award for Zero Trust Solution of the Year at the 2026 Pinnacle Awards, and Gold at the 2026 Cybersecurity Excellence Awards for AI Security Solution, as well as being a finalist for the Start-Up to Watch Award from the Global Semiconductor Alliance. We’re small enough that every person’s work visibly shapes the company, and we look for people who want to build, not just execute. Every employee holds equity, meaning your work directly builds your stake in the company’s future, not just a paycheck. If you want to help define what comes next, let’s talk.
  
  
**Job Description**
The Senior Emulation Engineer position is your opportunity to join one of the industry’s leading companies in platform security management and ransomware detection for cloud datacenters, 5G infrastructure and disaggregated compute ecosystems. We are looking for an emulation engineer to run and debug system-level workloads on Synopsys ZeBu emulation platforms and to own the integration and bring-up of transactors (XTORs) that connect the emulated SoC to real and virtual interfaces. Your focus is what happens once the design is running: getting the interfaces alive, executing firmware, OS, and use-case validation, triaging failures, and finding issues before silicon. This role is critical for validating the interoperability of our design with commercial AI servers, and for bridging the gap between hardware and software, as well as supporting SW development.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
****Runtime validation****

* Execute and debug system-level tests, firmware, and software workloads on ZeBu emulation models
* Bring up and validate secure boot flows (ROM, bootloader, Linux/RTOS) and platform security features such as root of trust, attestation, and firmware update on the emulated SoC
* Develop and run use-case scenarios covering platform security management, ransomware detection workloads, and datacenter/5G traffic patterns
* Triage failures and isolate root cause across RTL, firmware, driver, testbench, XTOR, and emulation environment; produce clear, reproducible bug reports
* Use ZeBu runtime debug capabilities (waveform capture, triggers, memory/register access, checkpoint/restore, force/release) to debug efficiently at speed
* Run and manage long-running regressions and soak tests; track pass rates, failure trends, and run-to-run stability
* Perform power-aware and performance validation runs: activity capture, bandwidth/latency profiling, and use-case benchmarking

****XTOR integration and bring-up****

* Integrate and configure ZeBu transactors and speed adapters (PCIe, CXL, Ethernet, NVMe, DDR/LPDDR, I2C/I3C/SMBus, SPI, UART, JTAG, etc.) at the testbench and runtime level
* Bring up XTOR-to-DUT links from first connectivity through link training, enumeration, and stable data traffic; resolve protocol-level and configuration issues
* Develop host-side software and drivers that control XTORs (C/C++, Python, SystemVerilog DPI, ZeBu API), including connections to real devices, virtual peripherals, or hybrid platforms
* Debug XTOR-related failures using protocol analyzers, waveforms, and logs; determine whether the issue lies in the DUT, the XTOR, clocking/speed-adapter configuration, or the host
* Tune XTOR configuration for throughput, latency, and emulation-frequency compatibility
* Maintain XTOR configuration, version control, and documentation across model releases
* Configure host servers, boot environments to interact with the emulated design
* Integrate, develop and debug transactors, bridges and protocol adapters as needed
* Debug and root-cause embedded HW, SW and test failures in emulation
* Collaborate with RTL, DV and SW teams to resolve system level bugs

**Qualifications**

* BS or MS degrees or higher in EE, CE or related fields
* 7+ years of hands-on experience in prototyping, emulation, SOC design and validation
* Self-driven, good problem solving and communication skills
* Hands-on experience running and debugging designs on Synopsys ZeBu (or comparable emulators such as Palladium or Veloce), including runtime control (NGTB or C based), waveform capture, and checkpoint/restore
* Experience integrating and debugging high-speed and low-speed interfaces
* Familiarity with embedded software bring-up and bootloader/kernel interactions
* Proficiency with scripting languages (Python, Perl, TCL) for automation
* Preferred qualifications include: experience in design verification, hardware/software co-simulation, Linux device drivers, bare-metal FW or boot loaders

Additional Information
  
  
Axiado is committed to attracting, developing, and retaining the highest caliber talent in a diverse and multifaceted environment. We are headquartered in the heart of Silicon Valley, with access to the world's leading research, technology and talent.
  
  
We are building an exceptional team to secure every node on the internet. For us, solving real-world problems takes precedence over purely theoretical problems. As a result, we prefer individuals with persistence, intelligence and high curiosity over pedigree alone. Working hard and smart, continuous learning and mutual support are all part of who we are.

Axiado does not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, non-disqualifying physical or mental disability, national origin, veteran status or any other basis covered by appropriate law. description:

Vanix Technologies is a deep tech product company specializing in the convergence of Artificial Intelligence and industrial hardware, with a strong focus on intelligent edge devices that process data and make decisions locally. Rather than simply connecting devices to the internet, Vanix embeds intelligence directly into hardware to enable real-time, on-device decision making. The company differentiates itself through vertical integration, designing proprietary PCBs and industrial enclosures, developing embedded AI models that run on-chip, and managing in-house production lines and automated testing frameworks. At Vanix, advanced research is transformed into reliable, scalable commercial products that operate in demanding industrial environments.

The Veterinary Domain Lead is a full-time, on-site role based in Hyderabad, responsible for shaping and driving Vanix Technologies’ veterinary-focused solutions within its deep tech product portfolio. Day-to-day responsibilities include creating domain documentation, use-case specifications, and validation protocols; coordinating pilot deployments; supporting training and enablement materials; and ensuring regulatory and ethical considerations are incorporated into product design. The role also includes cross-functional collaboration to prioritize features, monitor performance in real-world conditions, and continuously improve domain-specific capabilities.

* Candidates should possess capabilities in stakeholder communication and collaboration, including the ability to work closely with product managers, engineers, customers, and field teams.
* Candidates should possess familiarity with technology-enabled veterinary solutions, such as diagnostic devices, remote monitoring tools, practice management systems, or agritech platforms.
* Candidates should possess strong written and verbal communication skills to create clear documentation, training materials, and domain guidelines for internal and external audiences.
* Relevant qualifications such as a veterinary degree (DVM/BVSc or equivalent) or a related life sciences degree, combined with industry experience in veterinary or agritech sectors, are highly beneficial.
* Experience working in product-focused environments, especially with AI, IoT, or edge devices, and comfort operating in fast-paced, cross-functional teams is an advantage.

**Company: Drogo Drones Pvt. Ltd. (Drogo Aerospace)**

**Employment Type: Full-Time**

**Position: Senior System Integrator**

**About Drogo Aerospace**

Drogo Aerospace is a drone technology company specializing in the design, development, manufacturing, integration, and testing of Unmanned Aerial Vehicles (UAVs) for defence, surveillance, agriculture, and industrial applications.

We are looking for an experienced Senior System Integrator to lead the integration, testing, troubleshooting, and validation of advanced UAV platforms, including multirotor, fixed-wing, VTOL, and hybrid drone systems.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. UAV System Integration**

* Lead end-to-end integration of UAV hardware, software, avionics, propulsion, and communication systems.
* Integrate flight controllers, GPS/GNSS, IMUs, ESCs, motors, servos, sensors, telemetry modules, and payloads.
* Ensure compatibility and interoperability between electrical, electronic, mechanical, and software subsystems.
* Oversee integration of multirotor, fixed-wing, VTOL, and hybrid UAV platforms.

**2. Avionics & Flight Control Systems**

* Configure, integrate, and troubleshoot flight control systems using ArduPilot, PX4, Mission Planner, and QGroundControl.
* Integrate autopilot systems, navigation sensors, communication links, and ground control stations.
* Support flight controller calibration, parameter tuning, and system-level validation.
* Troubleshoot hardware-software interface issues.

**3. Testing & Validation**

* Develop and execute system integration testing procedures, including bench testing, Hardware-in-the-Loop (HIL), and ground testing.
* Conduct system-level verification and validation before flight trials.
* Analyze flight logs, telemetry data, and system performance to identify technical issues.
* Support flight testing, failure analysis, and corrective actions.
* Ensure system reliability, safety, and operational readiness.

**4. Electrical & Electronic Integration**

* Supervise wiring harness design, power distribution, PCB integration, and electrical subsystem connectivity.
* Integrate batteries, power management systems, propulsion controllers, and communication equipment.
* Interpret electrical schematics, wiring diagrams, and system architecture documents.
* Diagnose electrical faults, signal interference, and communication failures.

**5. System Architecture & Documentation**

* Collaborate with design, embedded software, mechanical, avionics, and flight-testing teams.
* Prepare system architecture diagrams, interface control documents (ICDs), integration plans, and test reports.
* Maintain technical documentation, configuration records, and integration checklists.
* Support design reviews, engineering change management, and product development activities.

**6. Team Leadership & Project Coordination**

* Lead and mentor system integration engineers and technicians.
* Coordinate integration activities across multiple UAV development projects.
* Identify technical risks and implement appropriate mitigation measures.
* Ensure timely completion of integration milestones while maintaining quality and safety standards.

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Aerospace Engineering, Aeronautical Engineering, Electronics & Communication Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Mechatronics, Robotics, or a related discipline.
* 10- 15 years of relevant experience in system integration in UAV's with respect to drone
* Strong understanding of UAV architecture, avionics, flight control systems, and communication protocols.
* Hands-on experience integrating complex electromechanical and embedded systems.
* Experience with CAN, UART, SPI, I2C, Ethernet, and other communication interfaces.
* Proficiency in troubleshooting electrical, electronic, and embedded system integration issues.
* Experience with UAV ground testing, flight testing, and system validation.
* Ability to interpret engineering drawings, technical specifications, and system interface documentation.

**Preferred Skills**

* Experience with fixed-wing, VTOL, hybrid, and long-endurance UAV platforms.
* Familiarity with ArduPilot, PX4, MAVLink, Mission Planner, and QGroundControl.
* Knowledge of GNSS/RTK, telemetry, RF communication, and payload integration.
* Experience with propulsion systems, including electric, internal combustion, and hybrid configurations.
* Familiarity with defence UAV development and mission-critical systems.
* Knowledge of DGCA UAV regulations, type certification processes, and applicable aerospace quality standards.
* Experience with system-level troubleshooting, root cause analysis, and reliability improvement.
* Strong leadership, communication, and cross-functional coordination skills.

title: Prompt Engineer
description:
Position Description
  
  
Prompt Engineer – Generative AI
  
  
Role Purpose
  
  
Centrica is looking for an experienced Prompt Engineer – Generative AI to design, develop, evaluate and optimise prompt based solutions using Large Language Models (LLMs) and Generative AI.
  
  
The role will work closely with product, engineering, data and business teams to translate real business problems into effective AI experiences and workflows.
  
  
The Prompt Engineer will take ownership of prompt design, prompt optimisation, evaluation, testing and guardrails, helping move Generative AI use cases from experimentation and proof of concept into reliable, secure and scalable production solutions.
  
  
The role requires a combination of strong analytical capability, understanding of LLM behaviour, hands on prompt engineering, experimentation, evaluation and sufficient technical knowledge to work effectively with AI engineers and software development teams.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  

* Prompt Engineering & Optimisation
* Design, develop and optimise prompts for Large Language Models and Generative AI applications.
* Create reusable prompt templates and prompt patterns for different business use cases.
* Apply techniques including: Zero shot prompting Few shot prompting Structured prompting Contextual prompting Role/task based prompting Tool/function oriented prompting
* Experiment systematically with different prompt structures, instructions and context.
* Improve output accuracy, consistency, relevance and reliability.
* Reduce hallucinations and undesirable model behaviour.
* Optimise prompts considering quality, latency and token/cost efficiency.
* Generative AI Solution Development
* Work with AI and software engineers to build Generative AI solutions that deliver measurable business value.
* Translate business requirements into effective LLM based interactions and workflows.
* Support use cases such as: Enterprise knowledge assistants Customer/service agent assistance Document summarisation and analysis Information extraction Classification Content generation Question answering Workflow automation Decision support applications
* Help move Generative AI capabilities from experimentation into production ready solutions.
* LLM Evaluation & Testing
* Develop systematic approaches for evaluating prompt and model performance.
* Define evaluation criteria covering: Accuracy Relevance Completeness Consistency Groundedness Hallucination Safety Response quality
* Build representative evaluation datasets and test scenarios.
* Conduct comparative testing across prompts, models and configurations.
* Perform regression testing following prompt or model changes.
* Analyse failure patterns and identify opportunities for improvement.
* Establish measurable acceptance criteria before prompts are promoted into production.
* Retrieval Augmented Generation (RAG)
* Work with engineering teams to design prompts for Retrieval Augmented Generation (RAG) solutions.
* Optimise how retrieved enterprise context is supplied to LLMs.
* Design system and user prompts that encourage grounded responses based on approved information.
* Support optimisation of retrieval and generation workflows.
* Evaluate whether responses are properly grounded in retrieved source material.
* Help identify whether poor results originate from retrieval, context, prompt design or the underlying model.
* Prompt Libraries & Reusable Patterns
* Develop and maintain a governed library of reusable prompt templates.
* Define standard patterns for common Generative AI use cases.
* Maintain appropriate prompt documentation and version history.
* Ensure prompt changes can be tested, reviewed and traced.
* Promote reuse rather than duplication across AI solutions.
* Capture lessons learned and effective prompting practices for wider engineering teams.
* Responsible AI, Safety & Guardrails
* Ensure prompt based solutions comply with Centrica's security, privacy, governance and responsible AI requirements.
* Design appropriate safeguards against: Prompt injection Jailbreak attempts Hallucination Sensitive information disclosure Harmful or inappropriate outputs Unintended model behaviour
* Define system level instructions and constraints for production AI applications.
* Work with Security, Data and AI Governance stakeholders to identify and mitigate risks.
* Support testing for bias, safety, privacy and explainability.
* Ensure human oversight is incorporated where appropriate.
* Business Requirement Translation
* Work directly with business and product stakeholders to understand problems that could benefit from Generative AI.
* Translate business requirements into clear AI tasks and prompt strategies.
* Facilitate discovery and experimentation sessions with users.
* Understand user journeys and determine where AI can genuinely improve outcomes.
* Challenge use cases where Generative AI may not be the appropriate solution.
* Convert user feedback into measurable prompt and solution improvements.
* AI Experimentation
* Experiment with different Large Language Models and model configurations.
* Compare models based on: Output quality Accuracy Reasoning capability Latency Cost Security Context window requirements
* Conduct controlled experiments to determine the most effective approach for each use case.
* Document findings and provide evidence based recommendations.
* Stay current with developments in LLMs, Generative AI and prompt engineering techniques.
* Production AI & Monitoring
* Work with AI engineering teams to integrate prompts into production applications and services.
* Ensure prompts are version controlled and deployed through appropriate engineering processes.
* Define monitoring requirements for prompt/model performance.
* Analyse production feedback and failure patterns.
* Support continuous improvement of live Generative AI services.
* Identify prompt/model drift or degradation.
* Contribute to incident investigation where AI behaviour affects production services.
* Collaboration with AI Engineering

Work closely with:
  
  

* AI / ML Engineers
* Software Engineers
* Data Engineers
* Data Scientists
* Product Managers / Product Owners
* UX / Conversation Designers
* Solution Architects
* Security teams
* Data Governance teams
* Business SMEs

Ensure prompt design is integrated into the overall engineering lifecycle rather than treated as an isolated activity.
  
  

* Documentation & Governance
* Document prompt purpose, design decisions and expected behaviour.
* Maintain prompt versions and associated evaluation results.
* Document known limitations and failure scenarios.
* Define appropriate usage guidance.
* Support governance reviews for production AI solutions.
* Ensure sufficient traceability between business requirements, prompt versions, testing and production releases.

**Mandatory Skills & Experience**
The successful candidate should have hands on experience with:
  
  

* Large Language Models (LLMs)
* Generative AI
* Prompt engineering and prompt optimisation
* System/user prompt design
* Structured prompting and few shot techniques
* LLM evaluation and testing
* Hallucination and groundedness evaluation
* Responsible AI and AI safety
* Working with LLM APIs / managed foundation model platforms
* RAG concepts and prompt design
* Python or equivalent scripting capability
* API based AI integration
* Git / source control practices

The candidate should also demonstrate:
  
  

* Strong analytical and problem solving skills.
* Ability to design structured experiments and interpret results.
* Ability to translate business problems into AI use cases.
* Strong written communication and language skills.
* Understanding of data privacy and security.
* Experience collaborating with software and AI engineering teams.
* Strong attention to detail and quality.

Desirable Technical Skills
  
  
Experience with the following would be advantageous:
  
  

* Python
* SQL
* Azure OpenAI / AWS Bedrock or equivalent managed AI platforms
* OpenAI compatible APIs
* LangChain / LangGraph or equivalent orchestration frameworks
* Vector databases
* Embeddings and semantic search
* RAG architectures
* Agentic AI / tool calling
* REST APIs
* CI/CD
* Docker / containers
* Cloud native AI deployment
* Prompt/model observability
* Automated LLM evaluation frameworks

Responsible AI Knowledge
  
  
Candidates should understand the risks associated with enterprise Generative AI, including:
  
  

* Hallucination
* Prompt injection
* Data leakage
* Bias
* Toxic or inappropriate output
* Privacy
* Explainability
* Model reliability
* Human oversight

They should be able to incorporate appropriate controls into prompt and solution design rather than treating responsible AI as a post development activity.
  
  
Key Competencies
  
  
Prompt EngineeringAble to systematically design and optimise prompts rather than relying on trial and error prompting.
  
  
Analytical ThinkingAble to define measurable evaluation criteria and use evidence to improve AI behaviour.
  
  
Generative AI UnderstandingUnderstands LLM capabilities, limitations and common failure modes.
  
  
Business Problem SolvingCan translate ambiguous business requirements into clearly defined AI tasks and workflows.
  
  
Engineering MindsetTreats prompts as production artefacts requiring versioning, testing, monitoring and controlled deployment.
  
  
Responsible AIUnderstands security, privacy, bias, hallucination and governance considerations associated with enterprise AI.
  
  
CollaborationWorks effectively across Product, Engineering, Data, Security and business teams.
  
  
Expected Outcomes
  
  
The Prompt Engineer will help Centrica to:
  
  

* Improve the quality and reliability of Generative AI solutions.
* Accelerate movement from AI experimentation into production.
* Establish reusable enterprise prompt patterns and standards.
* Reduce hallucinations and unreliable AI behaviour.
* Establish measurable evaluation frameworks for LLM applications.
* Improve grounding of enterprise AI through effective RAG prompting.
* Strengthen responsible AI controls.
* Improve user experience and adoption of AI solutions.
* Reduce repetitive manual work through effective AI automation.
* Deliver measurable customer and business value from Generative AI.

Candidate Profile
  
  
The ideal candidate is not simply someone who is good at writing prompts in ChatGPT.
  
  
We are looking for someone who understands how to engineer reliable LLM behaviour in an enterprise environment and can answer questions such as:
  
  
How do we measure whether this prompt is actually better? How do we prevent hallucinations? How do we ground the answer in enterprise data? How do we protect against prompt injection? How do we version and regression test prompts? How do we monitor quality after deployment?
  
  
The strongest candidate would combine:
  
  
Prompt Engineering + LLMs + Evaluation + RAG + Python + Responsible AI + Production Engineering Awareness
  
  
with the ability to work closely with business stakeholders and translate real Centrica use cases into effective AI solutions.

title: Sr Associate-International Regulatory Lead
description:
The International Regulatory Lead (Sr. Associate) is assigned to one or more Amgen products and may support an IRL or lead a program under the supervision of an experienced regulatory lead.
  
  

* Execute the international regulatory strategy and regulatory plans.
* Prepare supportive documentation for regulatory deliverables.
* Support regulatory product compliance (e.g. RIM, PMCs, ESC levels, and agency commitments).
* Support on the local label strategy and alignment to cCDS/reference label.
* Build effective relationships and communication paths across local and functional organizations.
* Enable efficiencies and seamless execution across the international countries.

**STRATEGY AND EXECUTION**

* Reviews and provides input to the international regulatory strategy documents (regulatory product filing plan, strategies, risks associated with the potential Agency outcomes and contingency planning, estimate likelihood of success). If leading a program, develops the regulatory strategy documents in collaboration with another regulatory lead and communicates to others, as applicable.
* Assists the International Regulatory Lead to support the regulatory activities (e.g. Clinical trial submissions, Marketing applications and lifecycle management filings) in compliance with global filing plans and local regulatory requirements. If leading a program, plans and manages regulatory submissions under general supervision.
* Provides and maintains CTA/MA documentation in collaboration with the International Regulatory Lead. When appropriate, the IRL could author documents/redact documents to support a regulatory filing.
* Assists the International Regulatory Lead by preparing supportive documentation for regulatory deliverables, including for example regulatory landscapes or research for the regulatory strategy and/or target product label.
* Performs QC of regulatory documentation (e.g. briefing packages).
* Supports Local Regulatory teams in triaging queries from health authorities, and where appropriate, help identify existing responses to same or similar questions, leveraging knowledge management.
* Advises and supports other groups on the review of promotional and non-promotional materials, as needed.
* Supports process improvement initiatives and metrics.

**COMMUNICATION AND COLLABORATION**

* Participates as a member of the Global Regulatory Team (GRT), Evidence Generation Team (EGT), Labeling Working Group (LWG), Clinical Study Team (CST), Regional Brand Team and others, as applicable (if leading a program or to support the IRL).
* Maintains regular communications with the local teams to ensure alignment on strategy and keep the countries informed of status on the product development.
* Partners with peers to ensure consistency in procedures.
* Builds effective relationships and communication paths across the Global and Local elements of the GRAAS function.

**Knowledge and Skills:**
**Scientific and Technical**
Knowledge of Regulatory principles.
  
  

* Working with policies, procedures and SOP’s.
* Comprehensive understanding of regulatory activities and how they impact other projects and/or processes.
* General knowledge of national legislation and regulations relating to medicinal products.
* Understanding of drug development.
* Demonstrate ability to work in teams.
* Ability to understand and communicate scientific/clinical information.

**Education & Experience (Basic)**

* Over all 5-9 years of experience
* Bachelors OR Master’s degree (scientific area) and 3 years of directly related experience to Regulatory Affairs

• Verify actuator firmware: control loops, position and force control, homing, end-stop and stall handling, fault and safe-state behaviour, and CAN/UART/SPI interfaces

• Build bench and hardware-in-the-loop setups that inject faults (overcurrent, encoder loss, supply dips, bus errors) and run regression tests on every firmware release

• Characterise actuators: force vs current, speed vs load, accuracy, repeatability, step response, efficiency, thermal rise, endurance and life

• Operate and improve our load and endurance rigs (1 to 20 kN class) and automate them in Python

• Calibrate and maintain instrumentation: load cells, linear encoders, current probes, DAQ

• Run root-cause analysis on failures and produce clear QT/AT reports with requirement-to-test traceability.

• B.E./B.Tech in Electrical, Electronics, Instrumentation, Mechatronics or similar

• 2 to 5 years in test, validation or firmware work on motor-driven or electromechanical products

• Working embedded C: you can trace a control loop and tell a firmware bug from a hardware or mechanical fault

• Motor control fundamentals: PWM, current sensing, PI loops, encoder or Hall feedback; BLDC, stepper or PMSM exposure

• Hands-on CAN, UART and SPI, including logging and decoding bus traffic

• Python for test automation, data logging and reporting

• Bench skills: oscilloscope, logic analyser, power supply, electronic load, safe handling of up to 48 V DC systems

• Real actuators from week one, close to the design and firmware team

• Ownership of the test function, with your reports feeding customer and certification submissions

• Hands-on learning across electromechanical and linear motor drives including defence/aerospace qualification practice
